changelog:
- Connects Codex to Asana through the OOMOL `oo` CLI and server-side credentials.
- Supports reading Asana workspaces, projects, tasks, sections, users, teams, tags, stories, attachments, and custom fields.
- Adds write actions for creating and updating tasks, projects, sections, teams, tags, comments, attachments, and custom fields.
- Includes relationship management for followers, members, tags, dependencies, subtasks, project placement, and task parents.
- Marks mutating and destructive actions clearly, with guidance to confirm payloads before changing or deleting Asana data.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@1d96f6f`
summary: Asana (asana.com). Use this skill for ANY Asana request — reading, creating, updating, and deleting data. Whenever a task involves Asana, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
